parameters.name: ObjectPath
parameters.description: Object path of the changed parameters.

object.description: Each ChangeSet entry contains the changes for a monitored object. If multiple monitored objects change within the {{param|##.Interval}}, there will be multiple ChangeSet entries. When a parameter of an already included object changes multiple times within in the configured {{param|##.Interval}}. The parameter must be included in the {{object}} instance, where the {{param|ObjectPath}} was previously used, and a new {{object|Parameter.{i}}} instance MUST be created.
